text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute shows everyone just how
strong
her will is as she races through
the twilight air of
Kawasaki.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Were you watching, everyone? Did you see me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I ran like a real star! My heart is still
burning!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This... is what it means to run. This is
what it
means to live.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't quite feel like myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It feels so good. My whole body is sore,
but it
feels so good. This is what
everyone has been
wanting to see...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That... was...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: AMAZING!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I always knew you were awesome! And I
always
knew you'd stand with me on
stage someday. But
still...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You were even better than I ever
imagined! I still
can't believe I got
front-row tickets to a beautiful
run like
that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You must be the person I've been
waiting for all
this time...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm sure of it! I'm so glad you've
finally
arrived... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon wraps Wonder Acute in a
tight hug.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's like watching an induction ceremony
into the
peak of dirt racing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Oh my. This is incredible... It's like a
hug from
Falco has erased all the
exhaustion I've forced on
myself...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I think, deep down, this is how I've
always
wanted to spend my youth.)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Falco! Falco!
Acute! Acute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon, the cries from the audience
envelop the
whole stadium, split evenly
between the two of
them. And then...

text_block_list.name: Amateur Boxers
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Miss Acute was incredible! That was like
the
perfect punch to the heart!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
It's like... if you really, really give it your
all... you
can shine just like this. Even if
you're not a born
champion, you can still
do it.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Take a good look at Miss
Acute right
now! That's what a real
fighter looks like!

text_block_list.name: Amateur Boxers
text_block_list.text: YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. I was thinking about taking the
day off,
but... yes... I guess I better go to
physical therapy
after all.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure my grandkids would just love to
see me
smile like that. Okay legs, let's
give it another go.
One more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is broadcast all over the
country, and
the glow radiating from
Wonder Acute is so
bright, it illuminates
the hearts of everyone who
sees her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. Today's race helped
me
realize something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
With enough elbow grease, even silver
can shine
like gold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that some Umamusume are born
with a
golden aura about them.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you were shining so brightly!
Yeah, you were really shining out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But there are others who shine like
silver, and
with enough polish, their
luster can rival gold.
Wonder Acute has
proved that today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only problem is what lies ahead. I
worry we
may start feeling the
consequences of pushing so
hard for this
race.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I can, I'd love to race Falco again next
time.
She always gives me such energy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer dear. Where should we go next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop myself and reconsider. Sure, the
G1
February Stakes is one of the biggest
dirt races,
but...
choice_data_list: Next up is the February S...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's right around the corner, which would
mean
we'd be running two races
back-to-back. That
would be rough on
Wonder Acute. And not only
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's quite likely Smart Falcon won't run
there
either, given that it would mean
running
consecutive races for her as well.
Taking that into
consideration, the G1
after that is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
May? That's quite a ways away. There
are a lot of
holidays around then too...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Kashiwa Kinen in May.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That means the kiddies will be off
school. Oh, I'd
just love it if Falco and I
could delight them with
a big race.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to keep up the hard work.
We can't...
stop... now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like her exhaustion's finally
caught up to
her. She can't even stay
awake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to make sure she's fully
recovered before
the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to have her back to her normal,
relaxed
self in time for the Kashiwa
Kinen, as if the
current stress never even
happened.
